_meta.description: Whole-string-literal renames at a major version: core form/view/action path strings that were renamed, safe to auto-rewrite by matching a PHP string literal's ENTIRE value exactly (never a substring, never inside a comment/identifier). Consumed by the data-driven rules under ElggMigrate\Rules\* via Rules\Shared\DataDrivenStringLiteralRenames (an AST String_-node visitor). Per-major.
_meta.why_all_representations: A core form has three string forms in plugin code: the short form/action NAME passed to elgg_view_form()/elgg_register_action()/elgg_generate_action_url() ('blog/save'), the full VIEW path ('forms/blog/save'), and the full ACTION path ('action/blog/save'). All three are listed so an exact whole-string match catches real usage.
_meta.excluded: View OVERRIDE files (views/default/forms/blog/save.php) are file renames, not string literals — those stay LLM-guided (manifest 007). The Elgg 7 members routes (collection:user:user → collection:user:user:all, search:user:user → collection:user:user:search) ARE now included below: the whole-string AST match is inherently prefix-safe — a literal equals at most one key, so the longer 'collection:user:user:all' is never clobbered by a rewrite of its prefix 'collection:user:user' — and DataDrivenStringLiteralRenames additionally resolves longest-key-first for an explicit, tested guarantee. The messages 'recipients'→'recipient' rename (manifest 013) is NOT here: 'recipients' is a common word with no whole-path form, so a literal match would corrupt unrelated strings; it needs an AST context guard and stays LLM-guided.
